CHAPTER 15 · ITEM 10 / 14

Shutdown, exit and supply

Market equilibrium with N firmsN 家企業的市場均衡

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Sum individual quantities supplied horizontally to find market supply with a fixed number of firms. Given market demand and the number of identical firms, solve for the short-run market price, market quantity, firm output and profit.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

先以 Nq(P) 得市場供給，再與市場需求相等求價。個別產量與利潤必須用企業自己的成本計算。

Sum each firm's q(P) horizontally. With identical firms, market supply is Nq(P). Equate this to market demand, solve P, then compute q and profit using the firm's own costs.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：TC=50+q²/2,MC=q, N=9; Qd=120−P. Each q=P, so 9P=120−P gives P=12,Q=108,q=12; profit=144−122=22.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Four identical firms each supply q=P. Demand Qd=100−P. Market price? 四家各供 q=P，市場價？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
